positions.title: Sabbatical
positions.description: After ~15 years of professional work, I am taking a moment to look back on what I learned, strengthen my "core", and identify new professional opportunities.

positions.title: Knowledge Activation Lead
positions.description:
Mission: Based on 3,5 years of hands-on venture building experience, enable all of BCG Digital Ventures to find and use information and insightsto build successful ventures, by supporting our peoplein understanding, using, and contributing to knowledge tools, processes, and rituals.

- Regional management of communication, roll-out, and further development of the global BCG Digital Ventures Intranet, co-led global concept and design of the project .

- Concept, planning and implementation of 40+ regional and global trainings on Knowledge Management topics with 500+ participants.

- Planning and execution of the global roll-out of two internal knowledge management tools.

positions.title: Strategic Design Lead
positions.description:
- General management of three venture projects over a period of 8 to 12 weeks in the areas of Energy, Mobility, and Industrial Goods. 
- Leadership of venture design & research teams, among others in the fields of Consumer, Finance, Insurance, Industrial Goods, Agriculture, and Mobility
- 40+ workshops in the areas of business development, vision, prototyping, design thinking, and stakeholder alignment
- Go-to-person for workshop design, presentation, vision, customer journey and ecosystem mapping

positions.title: UX Business Consultant

positions.title: Product Director

positions.title: Head Of Design
positions.description:

- Industrial design and UX/UI design from concept to prototyping, to testing, to implementation

company.name: Volkswagen Group
company.description:
The Volkswagen Group with its headquarters in Wolfsburg is one of the world’s leading automobile manufacturers and the largest carmaker in Europe. The Group is made up of ten brands from seven European countries: Volkswagen, Volkswagen Nutzfahrzeuge, ŠKODA, SEAT, CUPRA, Audi, Lamborghini, Bentley, Porsche and Ducati.


Our group sells vehicles in 153 countries and operates 114 production plants worldwide. Each working day, around 675,000 employees worldwide produce cars, are involved in vehicle-related services or work in the other fields of business. 

Our goal is to make mobility sustainable for us and for future generations. Our promise: With electric drive, digital networking and autonomous driving, we make the automobile clean, quiet, intelligent and safe. At the same time, our core product becomes even more emotional and offers a completely new driving experience. It is also becoming part of the solution when it comes to climate and environmental protection. In this way, the car can continue to be a cornerstone of contemporary, individual and affordable mobility in the future. #Shapingmobility
